chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ahmad ibn Idris (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Malik al-Kufi. He said: Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Mada'ini narrated to me from Fadl ibn Kathir from Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever meets a poor Muslim and greets him differently than the way he greets the rich, he will meet Allah the Mighty and Majestic on the Day of Resurrection while He is angry at him.

key_terms.سلام: Greeting (salam) — the Islamic greeting of peace
key_terms.غضبان: Angry — a state of divine displeasure

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Rida say about treating poor and rich Muslims differently?
ai.summary: Imam Ali al-Rida (AS) warns that whoever greets a poor Muslim differently than he greets a rich person will meet Allah on the Day of Resurrection with Allah angry at him. This teaching, from the assembly of 368 AH, reinforces the Islamic principle that all believers deserve equal respect regardless of wealth, and that discriminatory behavior based on financial status incurs divine wrath.

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ja`far b. Muhammad b. Malik al-Kufi. He said: Muhammad b. Ahmad al-Mada’ini narrated to me from Fadl b. Kathir from `Ali b. Musa al-Rida (as). He said:
Whoever meets a poor Muslim and greets him in a way that is different than the way he greets the rich, Allah will be angry when he meets Him on the Day of Resurrection.
